mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100), indicating a manufacturing slowdown, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above the 2% annualized growth rate signals robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2% annualized, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers a shift toward tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market contraction, which signals reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline in the same month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising residential investment (RSAFS) above the 5-year moving average, indicating a housing market boom, the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 5-year MA, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
